description: DOCUMENT SHAPE rules - the framework-owned half of tests/check_doc_shape.py, moved here from cities/newcastle/tests/ on 14 September 2026 (DECISIONS.md 9.171, #207) because the documents they govern are the simulator's, not one city's. check_doc_currency.py pins the NUMBERS a living document states from a city-owned claims file; this pins the SHAPE: the board stays a board, the brief stays short and stamped with the family it was written for, the record grows in order and on a template, the position pages carry a source for every number and stay inside a byte budget, every record section a living document cites exists, and a frozen document says so at the top. A path starting `docs/` or `tests/` resolves at the repository root; `{city}/` resolves at the active city. Every rule here was breached at least once (DECISIONS.md 9.132, 9.171).

board.last_updated_note: #208: the paragraph that starts **Last updated:** states the newest reading and the session, in at most two lines. The board re-accreted a session diary one sentence at a time in August and again in September; narrative belongs in the record.

brief.blocks_note: The lane block is generated from docs/lane.json by build_status_board.py into the board's Next section AND the brief's section 1, so the single next task has one home and two views.

positions.family_stamp_note: A position page is stamped with the family it was WRITTEN AGAINST, which is a frozen fact and cannot go stale. It used to say "Open family" - a LIVE fact whose home is the board and the ledger - and by 7 September 2026 seven of thirteen pages carried a family two or three boundaries old, because the brief was the only document whose stamp was checked. The stamp must name a family the ledger knows.
positions.bytes_note: #205: the 130-line cap bounded nothing because a line was a paragraph - eight of thirteen pages carried 20-40 lines of closed-family gate readings the record already held, and a current position averaged 25-45 KB. A page states the open family's position; a closed family's reading is a History line pointing at its record section.
positions.intro_note: 9.176: the intro paragraph named the results ("Two runs are results - ...") on all thirteen pages, a fact with thirteen homes; a session that read a new result updated five and left eight stale. Which runs are results is the board's runs block; the intro may not name a run.

archives.note: Every .md and .html under an archived/ directory carries a frozen/archive banner in its first lines; JSON evidence files are not prose and are skipped. The simulator's archive is empty since 14 September 2026 (its narratives were retired to git history, 9.171); the city's holds its frozen dossiers and diagnostics.

citations.note: Trap 4 of the forty-seventh brief: the board and two pages cited 9.170 for half a day while the record ended at 9.169. A living document may cite only a record section that exists; write the section before the citation.
